name: Cucumber and Behaviour-Driven Development
certifications: No official Cucumber certification; assessed by capstone projects
ISTQB Advanced Level Test Automation Engineering (CTAL-TAE)
tools: IntelliJ IDEA with the Cucumber plugin

beginner.summary: For testers, developers and business analysts starting behaviour-driven development with Cucumber. Covers BDD and why teams use it, discovery with example mapping, Gherkin syntax, writing good scenarios, step definitions with Cucumber Expressions, running features with JUnit 5 or TestNG, hooks, tags, Background, Scenario Outline, data tables and doc strings, sharing state between steps, Cucumber with Selenium and REST Assured, reports and running in CI.
prerequisites: Understands how software requirements are written and tested
Basic Java or another programming language for the automation days
Works in or with an agile team
outcomes: Explain BDD and run example mapping sessions with business and technical people
Write clear, declarative Gherkin scenarios that act as living documentation
Automate scenarios with Cucumber-JVM step definitions, hooks and tags
Connect Cucumber to Selenium and REST Assured and run features in CI with reports

days.topic: Cucumber and BDD Overview, Tools and Project Setup
subtopics: What behaviour-driven development is and is not
BDD compared with test automation alone
The three practices: discovery, formulation and automation
Installing Java, Maven and IntelliJ with the Cucumber plugin
Creating a Maven project with Cucumber dependencies
Folders for features and step definitions
The course application and project overview
tools: IntelliJ IDEA with the Cucumber plugin
days.lab_task: Create a Cucumber-JVM project with Maven, write a first feature file with one scenario, generate step definition snippets, implement them and run the feature.
days.deliverable: Working Cucumber project with a first passing scenario
checks: The project builds and runs the feature with mvn test
Undefined steps produce snippets that are implemented
The three BDD practices are explained in the team's words

days.topic: Discovery with Example Mapping and Three Amigos Sessions
subtopics: Three amigos: business, development and testing
Example mapping with rules, examples and questions
Spotting stories that are too big
days.lab_task: Run an example mapping session for three user stories with a role-played product owner and developer, record rules, examples and questions, and split one story that is too big.
days.deliverable: Example maps and a split story
checks: Each rule has at least two concrete examples
Open questions are recorded with owners
The large story is split into smaller stories

days.topic: Gherkin Syntax: Feature, Scenario, Given, When and Then
tools: IntelliJ IDEA with the Cucumber plugin
days.lab_task: Write a feature file for login with a description, rules and five scenarios using correct Given, When and Then steps, and review it with a partner for structure.
days.deliverable: Login feature file
checks: Each scenario has context, one action and outcomes
Scenarios are grouped under Rule keywords

days.topic: Writing Good Scenarios: Declarative Steps and Business Language
subtopics: Business language instead of UI details
days.lab_task: Rewrite ten imperative, click-by-click scenarios into declarative business scenarios, remove UI details and check each against a review checklist.
days.deliverable: Rewritten scenarios with checklist results
checks: No rewritten step mentions clicks or field IDs

days.topic: Step Definitions and Cucumber Expressions
subtopics: How Cucumber matches steps to code
Built-in types: int, float, string and word
Reusing steps without making them vague
days.lab_task: Implement step definitions for the login feature with Cucumber Expressions, use optional text and alternatives, and fix an ambiguous step error.
days.deliverable: Step definition classes for the login feature
checks: All steps match exactly one definition
Parameters are passed with Cucumber Expressions
The ambiguous step error is resolved

days.topic: Running Features with JUnit 5 Platform and TestNG
subtopics: Running from the IDE and from Maven
Dry runs to find undefined steps
Strict mode and failing on undefined steps
days.lab_task: Configure features to run with the JUnit 5 Platform engine, run a dry run to find undefined steps, then configure a TestNG runner and compare the two.
days.deliverable: JUnit 5 and TestNG runner configurations
checks: Features run through the platform engine
Undefined steps are listed without running scenarios

days.topic: Hooks: Before, After and Step Hooks
subtopics: Keeping hooks out of business logic
days.lab_task: Add hooks that start and stop a browser, take a screenshot after failed steps, clean up test data after scenarios and run a tagged hook only for API scenarios.
days.deliverable: Hook class with tagged hooks
checks: Browsers start and stop through hooks
The tagged hook runs only for tagged scenarios

days.topic: Tags and Organising Test Runs
subtopics: Tag expressions with and, or and not
Tags for requirement and ticket IDs
Running tags from Maven and the IDE
days.lab_task: Tag the scenarios for smoke, regression and ticket IDs, run tag expressions from Maven and write a short tag convention for the team.
days.deliverable: Tagged features and a tag convention
checks: Every scenario has a type tag and a ticket tag
Tag expressions select the right scenarios

days.topic: Background, Scenario Outline and Examples
days.lab_task: Refactor repeated context into a Background, turn five similar scenarios into a Scenario Outline with boundary examples and tag one Examples table as smoke.
days.deliverable: Refactored feature files
checks: Repeated Given steps move into Background

days.topic: Data Tables and Doc Strings
subtopics: Lists, maps and lists of maps
Doc strings for JSON and text
days.lab_task: Write steps that take a table of products and a JSON doc string, transform the table into objects with a DataTableType and use the doc string as a request body.
days.deliverable: Steps using data tables and doc strings
checks: The doc string is sent as a JSON body
Tables have clear headers and few columns

days.topic: Sharing State Between Steps with Dependency Injection
subtopics: A scenario context or world object
Scope of shared objects per scenario
days.lab_task: Replace static variables in step definitions with a scenario context injected by PicoContainer, share a browser driver and an API client, and show that scenarios no longer leak state.
days.deliverable: Injected context and refactored steps
checks: Steps receive the context through constructors
No step uses static shared variables
Two scenarios run without leaking data

days.topic: Cucumber with Selenium for UI Scenarios
subtopics: Waits inside page objects, not steps
Keeping UI details out of Gherkin
Running UI scenarios in parallel later
days.lab_task: Automate the checkout feature with Selenium page objects behind the steps, keep Gherkin free of UI details and attach screenshots of failures to the report.
days.deliverable: Automated checkout feature with page objects

days.topic: Cucumber with REST Assured for API Scenarios
subtopics: Request and response objects in the scenario context
Checking status and bodies in Then steps
days.lab_task: Write API scenarios for creating and searching orders, implement the steps with REST Assured and a shared context, and check responses with tables and doc strings.
days.deliverable: API feature with REST Assured steps
checks: Scenarios describe business outcomes, not HTTP calls
Steps call REST Assured through a client
Then steps assert status and body

days.topic: Reports: HTML, JSON, Allure and Living Documentation
subtopics: Third-party HTML reports such as Masterthought
days.lab_task: Produce HTML, JSON and Allure reports for the suite with attachments, publish a living documentation report and ask a business stakeholder to review it.
days.deliverable: Reports and stakeholder feedback
checks: HTML, JSON and Allure reports are generated
Screenshots and logs are attached to steps
A business stakeholder can read and comment on the report

days.topic: Running Cucumber in CI with Maven
subtopics: Passing tags and environments from the command line
Failing builds on failed or undefined steps
Running smoke on pull requests and regression nightly
days.lab_task: Run smoke-tagged scenarios on pull requests and regression nightly in CI, pass environments from the command line, publish reports and fail the build on undefined steps.
days.deliverable: CI pipeline with tagged runs and reports
checks: Pull requests run smoke and nightly runs regression
Reports are reachable from each run
An undefined step fails the build

days.topic: Parameter Types and Custom Transformations
days.lab_task: Define custom parameter types for money, dates and customer types, use them across three features and make invalid values fail with clear messages.
days.deliverable: Parameter type definitions and updated steps
checks: Money, date and customer types are defined
Three features use the custom types
Invalid values fail with clear messages

days.topic: Reviewing and Refactoring Feature Files
subtopics: Long scenarios and how to split them
Deleting scenarios that add no value
days.lab_task: Review a messy set of feature files with a checklist and a business stakeholder, remove duplicates, split long scenarios, align vocabulary with a glossary and record the changes.
days.deliverable: Refactored features, glossary and change log
checks: Duplicated scenarios are merged or removed
The stakeholder approves the revised features

days.topic: Cucumber in Other Languages: Cucumber-JS, Behave and Reqnroll
subtopics: Reqnroll for .NET teams as the SpecFlow successor
What stays the same across tools
Choosing a tool for a team's language
days.lab_task: Implement the same login feature in Cucumber-JS and Behave, list the differences from Cucumber-JVM and recommend a tool for a mixed-language organisation.
days.deliverable: Two implementations and a recommendation
checks: The feature passes in both tools
Differences in hooks, context and runners are listed
The recommendation fits the organisation's languages
objectives: Use BDD tools in other languages
Choose a tool for a team

days.topic: Debugging Cucumber Scenarios
subtopics: Debugging step definitions in the IDE
days.lab_task: Diagnose four broken scenarios (a glue path error, an ambiguous step, a failing hook and leaked state), fix them and write a debugging checklist.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and checklist
checks: Each failure has a recorded cause
The checklist covers the steps used

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: BDD Feature Set for an Online Store
days.lab_task: Run example mapping for three store features, write declarative feature files, automate them with UI and API steps and a shared context, tag them and run them in CI with a living documentation report.
days.deliverable: Feature set, automation code, reports and pipeline
checks: Example maps exist for each feature
Scenarios pass with UI and API steps
Tagged runs publish reports in CI
objectives: Go from examples to automated scenarios

intermediate.summary: For teams that already write and automate Cucumber scenarios and want BDD to scale. Covers BDD in the agile workflow, writing acceptance criteria as examples, framework layers behind steps, Spring and dependency injection, parallel execution, test data, combining UI and API steps, Cucumber with Playwright, mobile scenarios with Appium, flaky scenarios, traceability to Jira and Xray, living documentation, metrics, contract and service-level scenarios, database checks, reusable step libraries, performance of large suites, code quality and BDD for legacy systems.
prerequisites: Writes Gherkin scenarios and Cucumber-JVM step definitions
Works in an agile team with business stakeholders
outcomes: Run BDD as a team practice from discovery to living documentation
Build a layered, parallel Cucumber framework for UI, API and mobile scenarios
Connect scenarios to requirements and test management tools
Keep large feature suites readable, fast and trusted

days.topic: BDD in the Agile Workflow: From Backlog to Done
subtopics: Where BDD fits in refinement, planning and review
days.lab_task: Run BDD through a simulated sprint: discovery for three stories, scenarios written before coding, automation during the sprint and a review where the business reads the results.
days.deliverable: Sprint artefacts from discovery to review
checks: Scenarios pass by the end of the sprint
The product owner accepts stories from scenario results

days.topic: Acceptance Criteria as Examples: Specification by Example
subtopics: Key examples and how to find them
days.lab_task: Rewrite the acceptance criteria of five backlog items as rules with key examples, turn them into scenarios and check that each example illustrates a single rule.
days.deliverable: Rewritten acceptance criteria and scenarios
checks: Edge cases are shown as examples
Each example becomes one scenario or outline row

days.topic: Framework Layers Behind Steps: Steps, Domain Actions and Drivers
subtopics: Page objects and API clients as drivers
Reusing actions across UI and API
days.lab_task: Refactor a step library so steps call domain actions, which call page objects or API clients, and show that one action serves both a UI and an API scenario.
days.deliverable: Layered framework with shared actions

Packages separate steps, actions and drivers

days.topic: Cucumber with Spring: Configuration, Beans and Scenario Scope
subtopics: Testing Spring Boot applications with Cucumber
Startup cost and how to reduce it
days.lab_task: Move the framework to cucumber-spring with scenario-scoped beans and profiles for two environments, and test a Spring Boot service started in the same test context.
days.deliverable: Spring-based framework with environment profiles
checks: The Cucumber context loads with Spring
Scenario-scoped beans do not leak between scenarios

days.topic: Parallel Execution of Scenarios
subtopics: Parallel execution with the JUnit 5 Platform
Thread safety of drivers and state
Grouping scenarios that cannot run in parallel
days.lab_task: Enable parallel scenario execution, make drivers and state thread-safe, isolate data for parallel scenarios and compare suite duration with serial runs.
days.deliverable: Parallel suite with timing comparison
checks: Scenarios run in parallel and pass
No scenario shares mutable data with another
Suite time drops compared with serial runs

days.topic: Test Data for BDD Scenarios
subtopics: Data described in Gherkin compared with hidden data
Keeping scenario data meaningful to readers
days.lab_task: Replace hard-coded data in steps with builders and API seeding, keep the data that matters visible in Gherkin and clean up after each scenario.
days.deliverable: Data builders, seeding steps and cleaned-up scenarios
checks: Gherkin shows only data relevant to the behaviour
Scenarios seed their own data through APIs
Data is removed after each scenario

days.topic: Combining UI and API Steps in One Scenario
subtopics: Using the API for Given steps
Checking UI outcomes through the API
Deciding which steps use which layer
Keeping Gherkin independent of the layer
days.lab_task: Change five UI scenarios so their Given steps use the API and some Then steps verify through the API, keep the Gherkin unchanged and compare time and stability.
days.deliverable: Hybrid scenarios with comparison
checks: Given steps call APIs instead of the UI

days.topic: Cucumber with Playwright
subtopics: Playwright for Java or Cucumber-JS with Playwright
Browser and context management in hooks
Traces and screenshots for failed scenarios
days.lab_task: Implement the checkout feature with Playwright behind the steps, attach traces for failures and compare stability with the Selenium implementation.
days.deliverable: Playwright-backed feature and comparison

days.topic: Mobile Scenarios with Cucumber and Appium
subtopics: Screen objects for Android and iOS
Device configuration by tag or profile
Running on emulators and device clouds
days.lab_task: Automate a login and search feature for Android and iOS with shared Gherkin and platform-specific screen objects, and run it on an emulator and a simulator.
days.deliverable: Cross-platform mobile feature
checks: Both platforms use the same feature file
Screen objects exist for Android and iOS

days.topic: Flaky Scenarios: Causes, Retries and Fixes
subtopics: Timing, data, state and environment causes
Rerunning failed scenarios with the rerun plugin
days.lab_task: Find flaky scenarios by repeated runs, diagnose three, fix them, add a limited rerun policy and tag quarantined scenarios with owners.
days.deliverable: Flaky report, fixes and policy
checks: Flaky scenarios are listed with rates
Three scenarios pass fifty runs after fixes
Quarantined scenarios have owners and dates

days.topic: Traceability with Jira and Xray
subtopics: Importing and exporting features with Xray
Keeping Jira and repository in step
days.lab_task: Link scenarios to stories through tags, import results into Xray test executions from CI and produce a requirement coverage report.
days.deliverable: Linked scenarios and an Xray coverage report
checks: Every scenario links to a story
CI results appear in Xray executions

days.topic: Living Documentation for Business Stakeholders
subtopics: Descriptions, rules and examples as documentation
Getting business people to read it
days.lab_task: Organise features by business capability, add rule descriptions, publish a living documentation site from CI and walk a business stakeholder through it.
days.deliverable: Living documentation site and stakeholder feedback
checks: Features are grouped by business capability
The site updates with every CI run
A stakeholder answers a business question using the site

days.topic: Metrics for BDD Suites
subtopics: Scenario counts and what they hide
days.lab_task: Build a dashboard from Cucumber JSON results with pass rate, flakiness, duration, coverage and step duplication, and propose two improvements from the data.
days.deliverable: Dashboard and improvement proposals
checks: Two problems are identified from the data
Each problem has a proposed action

days.topic: Service-Level Scenarios: Contracts, Events and Back-End Behaviour
subtopics: BDD for services without a UI
Scenarios for business rules in services
Checking messages and events in steps
days.lab_task: Write scenarios for an order service's business rules, check emitted events in Then steps, stub a dependent service and poll for asynchronous outcomes.
days.deliverable: Service-level feature with event checks
checks: Scenarios describe business rules, not endpoints

days.topic: Database Checks in Steps
subtopics: When scenarios should check stored data
days.lab_task: Add database checks behind Then steps for three scenarios, keep table names out of Gherkin and clean up in hooks.
days.deliverable: Scenarios with database checks
checks: Feature files contain no table or column names

days.topic: Reusable Step Libraries Across Teams
subtopics: When to share steps between teams
Avoiding generic steps that hide meaning
days.lab_task: Extract common authentication and navigation steps into a versioned library, use it from two projects through glue configuration and document each step.
days.deliverable: Shared step library used by two projects
checks: The library is published with a version
Two projects use it through glue paths
Each shared step has an example

days.topic: Speeding Up Large Feature Suites
subtopics: Where time goes in large suites
API seeding instead of UI setup
Test impact analysis by tag and feature
days.lab_task: Profile a slow suite, cut hook and setup time, remove redundant scenarios, add tag-based tiers and report the new feedback time.
days.deliverable: Profiling results and optimised suite
checks: The slowest scenarios and hooks are identified
Suite duration drops by an agreed target
Smoke, regression and nightly tiers run by tag

days.topic: Code Quality for BDD Frameworks
subtopics: Coding standards for steps and actions
Code reviews for features and steps
days.lab_task: Lint the feature files, find duplicate and unused steps, run static analysis on step code, fix the main issues and agree a review checklist.
days.deliverable: Lint and analysis results, fixes and checklist
checks: Feature files pass the agreed lint rules
The review checklist covers features and steps

days.topic: BDD for Legacy Systems and Existing Test Suites
subtopics: Introducing BDD where tests already exist
Converting manual test cases into scenarios
days.lab_task: Choose a legacy feature, write characterisation scenarios for its current behaviour, convert five manual test cases into scenarios and automate the most valuable two.
days.deliverable: Characterisation scenarios and converted tests
checks: Only valuable cases are converted, with reasons
Two scenarios pass against the legacy system

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: BDD Practice for a Product Team
days.lab_task: Run BDD for a product team over a simulated release: discovery for five stories, a layered Spring framework with UI, API and service scenarios, parallel runs with seeded data, Xray traceability and living documentation reviewed by the business.
days.deliverable: Feature set, framework, traceability and documentation
checks: Every story has rules and examples before coding
Scenarios run in parallel and pass
The business reviews results in the living documentation

advanced.summary: For BDD coaches, automation leads and quality engineers who run BDD across several teams. Covers BDD strategy and adoption, coaching discovery, domain language and bounded contexts, screenplay architecture, framework architecture for many teams, BDD for microservices, compliance and audit evidence, BDD with AI assistance, large-scale traceability, BDD metrics, BDD in regulated and safety-critical work, governance of feature files, scaling living documentation, CI at scale, BDD with DevOps and continuous delivery, migration between BDD tools, rescuing failing BDD adoptions, training programmes and troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Has run BDD with Cucumber in at least one team
Has built and maintained a Cucumber framework
Works with product owners and engineering leads
outcomes: Lead BDD adoption across teams with a clear strategy and coaching
Architect Cucumber frameworks and living documentation for many teams
Use BDD for compliance, audit and regulated delivery
Measure, govern and rescue BDD practices

days.topic: BDD Strategy and Adoption Across Teams
subtopics: Why BDD adoptions succeed or fail
Goals for BDD in an organisation
Roles: coaches, champions and product owners
days.lab_task: Assess BDD readiness in four case teams, choose pilots, write an adoption roadmap with goals and measures and present it to engineering and product leaders.
days.deliverable: Readiness assessment, roadmap and presentation notes

The roadmap has pilots, phases and measures

days.topic: Coaching Discovery Sessions and Facilitation

Coaching product owners to bring examples

days.deliverable: Session outputs and feedback notes

days.topic: Domain Language, Glossaries and Bounded Contexts in Gherkin

days.deliverable: Glossary, context map and corrected features
checks: Each key term has a definition per context

days.topic: Screenplay Architecture for Large BDD Frameworks

days.deliverable: Architecture design, starter template and onboarding record

Ownership and support rules are written

days.topic: BDD for Microservices and Distributed Systems
subtopics: Journey scenarios compared with service scenarios

checks: Most behaviour moves to service scenarios

days.deliverable: Traceability map, evidence pack and audit notes
checks: Each requirement links to scenarios and results

days.deliverable: Draft and corrected scenarios with a review record
checks: AI drafts exist for all three stories

subtopics: Linking scenarios to epics and objectives
days.lab_task: Build a cross-team coverage and readiness report that links scenarios to epics for three teams, and present release readiness for a sample release.

checks: Scenarios link to epics across teams

subtopics: What success looks like for BDD
days.lab_task: Define measures for BDD value and practice health, collect sample data for three teams, compare them and recommend coaching actions for the weakest team.
days.deliverable: Measure set, comparison and coaching plan
checks: Measures cover discovery, defects and suite health
The coaching plan targets measured weaknesses

days.topic: BDD in Regulated and Safety-Critical Delivery
days.lab_task: Design a BDD process for a regulated product with formal reviews, separation of duties and evidence for certification, and test it on two features.
days.deliverable: Regulated BDD process and trial evidence

days.lab_task: Write governance rules for features and steps, apply them to a large repository with lint and review, retire outdated scenarios and report compliance by team.
days.deliverable: Governance rules, cleanup and compliance report
checks: Rules cover ownership, review, naming and retirement

days.topic: Scaling Living Documentation

days.deliverable: Documentation portal and usage report

Usage data is collected and reported

days.topic: CI at Scale for BDD Suites

days.deliverable: BDD programme plan, architecture and presentation
